COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   D. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   B. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   D. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   B. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   D. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   B. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   B. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.
   D. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2..
   B. Treat Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. as rumours only.
   C. Say Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

9. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   C. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.
   B. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   C. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the School Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Intercultural Competence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
